📸: Karen Loria

Over the past weekend I was hanging out with some of my buddies for a birthday party. The wine was flowing. Just for context, I’m 48 years old and have been a huge music fan since I was a kid. I grew up in the 80s and 90s and was exposed to some of the most amazing musical artists of all time.
 I basically listened to everything. Depeche Mode, Duran Duran, U2, Pearl Jam, Metallica, STP, Guns N’ Roses, etc. And of course, one of my absolute favorites has always been Radiohead.
 Over the past 10 years or so, Tame Impala has become my number one artist. My current rotation of albums that I listen to on a weekly basis consists mostly of:
 • Tame Impala
 • The Strokes
 • Kanye West
 • Bob Moses
 • Radiohead
